full_description: use the arm named in the instruction to pick up the block; the arm word (left vs right) is the ONLY signal of which arm to use
schema: {A} notifies the block. {a} notifies the arm (a left-family word when the task is to use the left arm, a right-family word when the task is to use the right arm) — it is the ONLY signal of which arm to use. Every template MUST contain both {a} and {A}. Do NOT write 'the' immediately before {A} or {a}; both already render with a leading article.
preference: num of words should not exceed 7!!!!!. Degree of detail avg is 2. Keep the arm slot {a} present in every template as the only discriminator.
